cli.help: Extracts the tweets of one or more X accounts between two dates → one CSV per account.
cli.opt_lang: Language for messages: es or en (defaults to the system's).
cli.extract: Extracts on the server side (twscrape or the official API). Every access goes through the Compliance Gate (sliding 24-hour cap); running it again skips the stretches already done.
cli.capture: Queues captures for the extension, one per account: it takes them one at a time while the browser with xport is open, and the service exports each CSV as it finishes.
cli.opt_account: Account handle (without @). Repeat the option or separate several with commas.
cli.opt_out_dir: Folder for the CSVs (default: csv/ in the data folder).
cli.opt_encoding: CSV encoding (default utf-8; utf-8-sig adds a BOM for Excel).
cli.opt_delimiter: CSV delimiter (default ','; ';' for Excel set to Spanish).
cli.opt_excel: CSV for Excel set to Spanish (UTF-8 with BOM and ';').
cli.result: {account}: {exported} tweets → {path} ({saved} new; {run} stretches run, {skipped} skipped by checkpoint)
cli.gate: Gate: {usage} accesses in the 24-hour window; {remaining} left under the cap.
cli.queued: The extension takes them one at a time while the browser is open; progress and CSVs are at http://localhost:8000/.
launcher.help: Starts xport and opens its page in your browser.
launcher.opt_command: open (default): starts it if needed and opens the page; start: only starts it; stop: closes it; status: tells whether it is running.
launcher.port_busy: Another program is using port {port}, which xport needs for its page and its extension. Close that program and open xport again.
launcher.died: xport could not start. The details are in {log}.
launcher.slow: xport is not answering yet. Wait a moment and open it again; if nothing changes, the details are in {log}.
launcher.no_pid: xport is running, but I cannot find its process number ({path}): close it from wherever you started it.
datadir.moved_left: moved {old} to {new}; {left} files that were already in {new} stayed behind
datadir.merged_ledger: added {n} accesses from the old record {old} to {new} and deleted it
datadir.kept: left {old} alone: {new} already exists and I don't mix the two databases
app.already_running: another xport is already running at {url}: I won't start a second service, because two services would keep two records of the 24-hour cap. Use that one, or stop it before starting this one.
config.data_dir_absolute: XPORT_DATA_DIR has to be an absolute path: {path}
gate.over_cap: a request for {n} exceeds the hard_cap of {cap}
provider.no_cookies: The X_AUTH_TOKEN/X_CT0 cookies are missing from the environment (.env). Load a separate X account.
provider.twscrape_failed: twscrape couldn't complete the search request (invalid or suspended account, or rate limit used up)
provider.no_bearer: X_API_BEARER_TOKEN is missing from the environment (.env): the official backend needs the Bearer token of an X app with access to full-archive search.
provider.api_not_json: the X API returned something that isn't a JSON object
provider.api_402: the API account has no credit
provider.api_403: the plan or the app has no access to full-archive search
error.cross_site: request refused: it comes from another site, not from xport's page
error.gate_full: the global 24-hour cap is reached: ingestion is paused
error.job_not_ready: the job is '{status}': the CSV isn't ready yet
error.job_no_csv: account {account} has no CSV in this job
error.csv_gone: the CSV is no longer there
error.bad_delimiter: the separator has to be a single character, not a quote or a line break
error.no_accounts: at least one account is needed
error.not_x_handle: @{handle} isn't an X username (letters, numbers and _, up to 15)
error.browser_off: xport's own browser is off: captures use the extension in your browser
error.browser_busy: xport's browser is capturing: if X asks you to log in, the window opens by itself
note.empty: I found no tweets: does the account exist, is it public, and did it post between those dates?
note.account_quiet: I found no tweets: @{account} exists and is public, but X's search brought nothing between those dates. Either it didn't post, or X hides it from search.
note.account_protected: I found no tweets: @{account} is a protected account, only its approved followers can see it. To capture it, the X account xport captures with has to follow it.
note.account_suspended: I found no tweets: X suspended the account @{account}.
note.account_not_found: I found no tweets: the account @{account} doesn't exist on X (or it was deactivated). Is it spelled right?
note.account_blocked: I found no tweets: @{account} blocked the X account xport captures with.
note.account_unavailable: I found no tweets: X doesn't show the account @{account} ({reason}).
note.stopped_popup: You stopped it from the popup.
note.reset_popup: You deleted what was captured from the popup.
note.stop_cap: The gate's 24-hour cap filled up, so I stopped the capture. You can carry on once the oldest accesses leave the window (the popup shows how many are left).
note.stop_offline: The local service isn't answering at {base}, so I stopped the capture rather than see tweets the 24-hour cap can't count. Start the service and capture again.
note.stop_rejected: The service rejected the capture ({status}), so I stopped it. Check the service log.
note.stop_format: x.com changed the shape of its data and xport needs an update. I stopped the capture so it wouldn't carry on into an empty CSV; the service log has an example.
runner.no_cage: Capturing without a window needs cage (Linux only, for now); until then, captures use your browser.
runner.no_browser: I couldn't find Chrome, Chromium or Edge, so captures use your browser.
runner.no_extension: I couldn't find the built extension (extension/dist/chrome-mv3), so captures use your browser.
runner.closed: xport's browser closed on its own.
runner.error_page: X won't let the page load (an error page, like the 403 X gives to headless mode).
runner.extension_refused: The browser didn't accept the extension ({error}).
runner.crashed: {reason} It failed {count} times in a row, so captures go back to your browser.
runner.gave_up: {reason} Meanwhile, captures go back to your browser.
runner.no_display: X wants a login and there's no display to open the window on.
runner.login: Log in to X in xport's Chrome window (a separate account is best).
runner.login_window_failed: I couldn't open the login window ({error}).
runner.login_closed: The window was closed without logging in to X.
notify.login_body: A Chrome window from xport just opened: log in to X there, just once. A separate account from your own is best.
page.tagline: The tweets of one or more X accounts between two dates, one CSV per account.
page.offline: xport's service isn't answering. If you closed it, open it again; this page updates by itself.
page.accounts_hint: One or more, separated by commas or spaces. No @.
page.future: “To” can't be a date that hasn't come yet.
page.queued: Queued: {names}. The extension takes them one at a time.
page.browser_default: The browser with the xport extension runs them, one account at a time.
page.gate_hint: xport never goes past 900,000 tweets seen in 24 hours: X penalizes going over a million.
page.excluded: It leaves out {count} replies to other accounts: the CSV has the account's own tweets and threads.
page.nothing_yet: No tweets have come in yet.
page.progress: Up to {date}: {percent}% of the range, {count} tweets.
page.cancel_confirm: Cancel the capture of @{account}? What's already saved stays.
page.paused: Its x.com tab is hidden: go back to that tab so it keeps going.
page.waiting: X paused the search for a while: it waits and carries on by itself. Nothing to do.
page.waiting_until: X paused the search for a while: it waits until {time} and carries on by itself. Nothing to do.
page.gate: {usage} of {cap} tweets seen in the last 24 hours ({percent}%).
page.gate_full: It's full: captures wait for the oldest ones to drop out.
page.browser_idle: xport's own browser runs them, with no window at all: you don't have to do anything.
page.browser_running: xport's own browser is capturing, with no window in sight.
page.browser_login: Log in to X in the xport Chrome window that just opened (only once).
page.browser_extension: The extension in your browser opens the search in a tab: keep it open and visible while it captures.
page.browser_first_login: Before the first capture, log in to X in xport's browser. A separate account is better than your everyday one; you only do it once.
